description: Georgia O'Keeffe brushing her Chow, Beau, on a wooden table on the portal at Ghost Ranch.  O'Keeffe is standing leaning over the table brushing the back dog wearing gardening gloves, a dark shirt and skirt ( or could be a wrap dress?) with a striped apron, hair is pulled back in a bun; adobe walls, window, door, flagstone, wooden bench, wooden shelf in background with various antlers and rocks.
title: Georgia Brushing Beau
